content: There are also cases in which the answer can be inferred from the text, but where commonsense knowledge is still beneficial: The text for example UID28 does not contain the information that breakfast is eaten in the morning, but it could still be inferred from many pointers in the text (e.g. phrases such as I woke up), or from commonsense knowledge.
